comments.author: sakiffxiv
comments.body_html:
Open your Tarkov game directory. For example: 【X:\Escape from Tarkov\SPT\user\mods\AllinWeaponUnslotted\config】

Then use Notepad to open 【config.jsonc】

Find this line: 【 FckMagazines“: true, // true/false - default: true】

【Change true to false, like this: FckMagazines“: false, // true/false - default: false】

Save the file and close it. Then start the game, and the weapon magazines and ammo will return to their original state.
